---
name: Compatibility or display bug
about: Report a reproducible problem with the patch
title: ''
labels: ''
assignees: ''
---

**Environment:** Windows version, game edition/language, EXE SHA-256, patch commit,
resolution, windowed/fullscreen mode and relevant pc2fix.ini display settings.

**Reproduction:** Steps, view/map/zoom level, expected behavior and actual behavior.

**Evidence:** Relevant sanitized log lines or a screenshot, if helpful.
For a crash, include the exception code and fault offset if available.

Do not upload original game EXEs, DLLs, assets, saves or credentials.
